In a longitudinal randomized trial of 82 psychiatric patients, dropout from a low-threshold exercise intervention was associated with higher depressive symptoms, lower education, substance use, and inpatient status [PMID 42954124]. In a survey of 1,635 adolescents, anhedonia (loss of pleasure/interest) was positively associated with depressive symptoms, with interpersonal emotion regulation partially mediating the association [PMID 43022136].
